definitions: The action or process of inducting someone to an organization or into military service.
The formal act of placing someone in a new job, position, or office.
The process of inferring a general law or principle from particular instances.
The production of an electric current or magnetic state in a body by proximity to an electrified or magnetized body without contact.
The process of initiating childbirth by artificial means.
examples: The company held several inductions for new employees.
His inductions into the Hall of Fame were celebrated.
Scientific inductions are crucial for theory building.
Electromagnetic inductions are fundamental to many technologies.
Medical inductions can be a complex process.
